Package com.eqixiac.equinix.internetaccess.client

package com.eqixiac.equinix.internetaccess.client
Internet Access client interfaces for the Equinix Java SDK. Provides typed access to the Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v2 API, which exposes a single operation — creating a service via POST /internetAccess/v2/services. The service connections, IP blocks and routing configuration (direct, static or BGP) are all supplied as a single nested request body assembled through the service builder.

  • Interfaces
    Class
    Description
    InternetAccessAccounts
    Client interface for the Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 account lookups — the billing accounts available at an IBX (GET /internetAccess/v1/accounts), a single account by number (GET /internetAccess/v1/accounts/{accountNumber}) and an account's agreements (GET /internetAccess/v1/accounts/{accountNumber}/agreements).
    InternetAccessCabinets
    Client interface for the Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 product-availability lookup (GET /internetAccess/v1/cabinets) — the cabinets a customer has, optionally narrowed by cage, IBX and account.
    InternetAccessCages
    Client interface for the Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 product-availability lookup (GET /internetAccess/v1/cages) — the cages a customer has in a given IBX.
    InternetAccessConnectionServices
    Client interface for the Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 product-availability lookup (GET /internetAccess/v1/connectionServices) — the connection services available at a given IBX.
    InternetAccessIbxs
    Client interface for the Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v2 product-availability lookup (GET /internetAccess/v2/ibxs) — the IBX data centers where Equinix Internet Access is available for a given service connection type.
    InternetAccessOperationalUnits
    Client interface for the Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 operational-units lookup (GET /internetAccess/v1/operationalUnits) — the Equinix operational units serving a given IBX.
    InternetAccessOrders
    Client interface for the Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 order single get (GET /internetAccess/v1/orders/{orderUUID}).
    InternetAccessPatchPanels
    Client interface for the Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 product-availability lookup (GET /internetAccess/v1/patchPanels) — the patch panels a customer has in a given cage and cabinet.
    InternetAccessPrices
    Client interface for the Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 price search (POST /internetAccess/v1/prices/search).
    InternetAccessProductConfigurations
    Client interface for the Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 product / attribute configuration lookups — the read-only endpoints under /internetAccess/v1 that return the allowed and default configuration values (routing, bandwidth, connection, port) for ordering an EIA service.
    InternetAccessPurchaseOrders
    Client interface for the Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 purchase-order lookups — the list (GET /internetAccess/v1/accounts/{accountNumber}/purchaseOrders) and the single get (GET /internetAccess/v1/accounts/{accountNumber}/purchaseOrders/{number}).
    InternetAccessServices
    Client interface for the Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v2 service lifecycle.
    InternetAccessSignaturePolicies
    Client interface for the Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 signature-policies lookup (GET /internetAccess/v1/signaturePolicies) — the signature policies governing order acceptance.
    InternetAccessTerms
    Client interface for the Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 terms-and-conditions lookup (GET /internetAccess/v1/terms) — the terms and conditions applicable to an account at a given IBX for a given product.
